fields.label: Coordinator
fields.help: The chip the Zigbee coordinator is built on; its maker's page says which.

fields.label: Serial port
fields.help: Its path on this machine; /dev/serial/by-id/ keeps it the same across restarts. Docker Desktop on Windows and macOS cannot pass USB through.
fields.patternMessage: A device of this machine, under /dev

fields.label: Baud rate
fields.help: How fast the machine talks to the coordinator over USB. Leave it unset unless its maker says otherwise: Zigbee2MQTT's own default, 115200, suits most.

fields.label: Hardware flow control (RTS/CTS)
fields.help: Only for a coordinator whose maker asks for it, such as some EFR32 sticks at 460800.

fields.label: Address
fields.help: Where the coordinator listens, as its maker gives it.
fields.patternMessage: tcp:// followed by the address and the port

fields.label: Web page port
fields.help: Zigbee2MQTT's own page - the network map, pairing, each device's own settings - on this port of the machine. Without a token below it asks for no password: anybody on the network who opens it controls Zigbee.

fields.label: Web page password
fields.help: Asked by Zigbee2MQTT's own page before it lets anybody in. Leave it empty to keep the page open to the whole network.

fields.label: Advanced settings
fields.help: The radio, the log, how soon a device counts as gone, firmware updates.

fields.label: Zigbee channel
fields.help: Only used when the Zigbee network is first formed; changing it afterwards means pairing every device again. 15, 20 and 25 keep clear of the usual Wi-Fi channels.

fields.label: Transmit power
fields.help: The coordinator's radio power. Unset, it keeps what its firmware chose; not every coordinator takes it.

fields.label: Turn the coordinator's LED off
fields.help: For a coordinator whose firmware lets Zigbee2MQTT turn it off.

fields.label: Log detail
fields.help: How much Zigbee2MQTT writes in its log, on its container's page. Debug is for chasing a problem: it is a lot.

fields.label: Last seen
fields.help: Whether each device reports when it was last heard from, and how.

fields.label: Mains devices count as gone after
fields.help: Minutes without an answer before a device on mains power is shown as unreachable. 10 unless set.

fields.label: Battery devices count as gone after
fields.help: Minutes of silence before a device on batteries is shown as unreachable; they sleep, so it is long. 1500 unless set.

fields.label: Look for firmware updates on its own
fields.help: Zigbee2MQTT asks each device now and then whether its maker has newer firmware. Nothing is installed without being asked.

fields.label: Look for firmware updates every
fields.help: Minutes between two looks. 1440, once a day, unless set.

fields.label: Remember device states across restarts
fields.help: Zigbee2MQTT keeps what each device last reported, and says it again after it starts.
